Subject: Request: COI, tax docs, and vendor risk details for BlueHarbor setup

Hi Samantha —

Thanks for confirming the pilot stripe earlier. To get BlueHarbor set up in our procurement system and issue the PO, our Finance and Procurement teams need a few onboarding items:

- Certificate of Insurance (COI) showing Commercial General Liability with at least $1M per occurrence / $2M aggregate and Additional Insured line for Redwood Inference.
- W9 or equivalent tax form (for US vendors).
- Completed vendor risk questionnaire or at minimum a security self-assessment (SSAF-level/high-level controls).
- Legal contact for MSA questions and preferred billing address for PO.

If you can attach the COI and W9 in reply that will speed things up. Also confirm your full legal entity name and the remit-to address to populate the PO.

Next steps from our side once we have these: Lauren will create the vendor record and issue a preliminary PO number; Vivek will validate tax info for payment setup. If there are any timing constraints around insurance expiry or limits, flag them here.

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick call if easier.

Best,
